STEP 17. Check for short circuit to ground and harness 
damage between barometric pressure sensor connector B-
14 terminal 2 and ECM connector C-58 terminal 51 <M/T> 
or PCM connector C-55 terminal 55 <A/T>.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Replace the volume air flow sensor. Then go to Step 
18. 
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 18.
STEP 18. Test the OBD-II drive cycle.
(1) Carry out a test drive with the drive cycle pattern. Refer to 
P.13B-4, Procedure 6 − Other Monitor.
(2) Check the diagnostic trouble code (DTC).
Q: Is the DTC P0107 is output?
YES : Retry the troubleshooting.
NO : The inspection is complete.
